objective: Use Branch Handoff Protocol v1 and the explicit project-owner authorization KU2D-H-000011 to execute exactly one bounded, non-production Q-Diving YouTube live pilot against exactly two previously reviewed videos, validating public metadata plus bounded public comments/replies behavior under the merged YouTube Acquisition Pattern v2 while preserving Thai/English-only transcript scope and performing no caption download or OAuth/owner-authorized caption acquisition.
instructions: Perform Branch Handoff Protocol v1 mechanically: close the current source queue before switching, then create/switch to codex/ku2d-youtube-qdiving-live-pilot-v1 from integration/data-acquisition-platform at exact merge commit b93dfbfa26260bb7613a7fbb56f76d62242c5b1b and initialize the target queue as sole authority.

Treat KU2D-H-000011 as the sole human authority for this live pilot. Do not broaden it. The authorized live scope is exactly two previously reviewed Q-Diving videos, public metadata, and at most two comment pages per video.

Resolve the exact two video identities only from merged reviewed Q-Diving evidence. If the reviewed evidence does not identify exactly two unambiguous videos, fail closed and submit evidence_withheld; do not substitute, search for, or discover new videos.

Use only documented public YouTube Data API methods already permitted by the merged YouTube v2 contract for this pilot. Do not use YouTube HTML scraping, undocumented/internal endpoints, browser/Edge acquisition, proxying, CAPTCHA/challenge handling, login flows, or access-control bypass.

Acquire the approved public metadata for each of the two resolved videos and preserve acquisition timestamp, source method, video/channel identity, relevant metadata/statistics snapshot typing, provenance, quota accounting, and evidence references. Statistics are observation snapshots only and must not be interpreted as causal or representative measures.

For comments, acquire published top-level comment threads and replies only where publicly enabled. Cap commentThreads pagination at two pages per video. Use comments.list only when required to resolve replies that are not fully represented in embedded replies, and keep total comment/reply request behavior within a separately recorded bounded request/quota ledger. Do not exceed the two-page commentThreads limit per video.
Preserve requested/API ordering strictly as acquisition context. Do not infer representativeness, sentiment, popularity, demand, or population opinion from ordering, counts, or the retained sample.

Handle comments_disabled, no_comments, unavailable/deleted video, partial replies, pagination truncation, quota boundary, and API-access boundary as explicit statuses distinct from technical extraction failure. Record whether embedded replies are complete relative to totalReplyCount where the API exposes it.

Transcript/caption scope remains Thai and English only. This Prompt does not authorize captions.list, captions.download, OAuth, owner authorization, public-transcript scraping, audio/video download, or any transcript-content acquisition. Retain only any already-permitted metadata-level caption/language availability signal exposed by public metadata; never retain transcript text in any language in this pilot.

Evidence must be durably written before the next live request wherever the executor contract supports checkpointing. Preserve exact request counts, quota-unit accounting, page counts, result counts, per-video module statuses, provenance completeness, relationship integrity, and any withheld/partial evidence.

Run Deep Audit using the merged YouTube v2 contract. Metadata is required. Comments remain an optional pilot module: comments_disabled or no_comments must not by itself cause technical failure, but missing provenance, relationship corruption, quota-accounting failure, unbounded pagination, or evidence-write failure must fail closed.

Do not mutate active production policy to enable comments globally. This is a one-off explicitly authorized pilot only. Do not schedule recurring acquisition, approve production storage, promote Candidate Learning Evidence/Reviewed Corpus/Core Knowledge/Human Confirmation/Ground Truth, or mutate parked references.

Do not commit API keys, OAuth material, raw credentials, cookies, session state, or raw private data. If an approved API credential is unavailable in the execution environment, fail closed without inventing or requesting a workaround and report the exact execution boundary.

After live execution, add sanitized durable pilot evidence, a human-readable pilot report, deterministic regression fixtures/tests for newly observed behavior, and only the minimum code changes required to support the bounded pilot without broadening the v2 contract.
Open/update a single PR against integration/data-acquisition-platform, perform safe mechanical PR operations including Ready transition only after exact-head CI is green, and do not merge.

Submit KU2D-R-000036 with completed_queue_summary covering work completed, exact two video identities, live request/quota/page counts, metadata outcomes, comment/reply outcomes, transcript/caption non-execution confirmation, Deep Audit results, new evidence or boundaries, repo/knowledge changes, out-of-scope actions not performed, remaining risks, and recommended next logical step.
